comments.value: I agree it is annoying, but I think it should be toggleable or about to change the key bind to something else.
Cool feature but please but it on a toggle or something so that it doesn't mess with our custom bindings and stuff.
using the double tap for quick recalibration and playspacing,  this change is unneeded imo. you have the .2 seconds to open the menu via the button in the small menu, no need for this change.

Thanks for all the feedback here and on other platforms!

We're working on it and will get some iteration in next week.
This is also a common way to open world menus

This double click action should be a option in the SteamVR bindings & not be done in VRChat it self.

Be consistent, either do the bindings in VRChat or in SteamVR. & no hiden things. Expose all options.

When the main menu is open & i press the quick menu button twice to close the main menu & open the quick menu it just opens the main menu. But I just was there. This makes no sense. Also it doesn't even remember where I was. So why have a shortcut to bring back the main menu without a specific page.
@{5f305f4eda52487c3a339d88|full_name} this is my main complaint with this change, hitting the menu button for closing a menu should not count for the double click to open the main menu

Double-click menu is a bad design decision in the first place because it leads to many beginners accidentally doing it and not understanding what just happened.

It can also lead to a lot of issues with existing bindings for other programs (which are the issues that affect me personally).

I understand if it must happen. In that case, at least give the option to turn it off.
could there maybe be explanation on what has changed to mark this as available in the future release?
@{5b3ae0268996fa139166a02d|full_name}: We implemented a toggle that allows you to turn this behavior off. It'll ship with our next beta!

details:
A LOT of people use this binding to reset SlimeVR or their OVR Playspace Offset. So I’m considering this experimental change a BAD change because of it.

Please, for the love of god, revert this change! And please consider the possibility of separating Main Menu, Quick Menu, and Action Menu bindings more distinctively! SteamVR can do a lot better with bindings that what legacy methods can do.
title: [1487] Double-Click Menu Button to open Main Menu is a bad change.
